{{Top|leg}}
A '''plasma generator''' was a type of device used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The industrial [[planet]] [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]] used [[impact sifter]]s and [[chemical churner]]s to produced [[Fuel cell/Legends|fuel cores]] during the war.<ref name="Death-Hunter">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Plasma generators were mentioned in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] adventure "[[Death-Hunter]]," written by [[Tony Russo]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[February]] [[1996]] in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''.<ref name="Death-Hunter" />
